items.title: Jimmy Wormworth interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 6, 2002
items.q: My father was a close friend of Billy Kyle... And one of his idols was Billy Kyle.

ctx.x: So many of those people are gone now. My father was a close friend of Billy Kyle, the great pianist, and curiously enough I was a close friend of the late Al Haig and worked with him for a long time and became a really close personal friend. And one of his idols was Billy Kyle.
Who were the musical people in Utica that you kind of looked up to at the time?
